projects.name: Viet Corner Website
projects.description: A bilingual, real-time website for a local Vietnamese church community. It includes an admin system that lets non-technical staff manage events and nested discipleship courses, locations and classes.
highlights: Three-level Firestore subcollection model with cascade deletes and confirmation warnings
English ↔ Vietnamese toggle via a custom, type-safe translation context
Firebase security rules enforce admin-only writes; TypeScript across 50+ components

projects.name: LU Essentials Store
projects.description: A responsive Vue 3 single-page storefront and inventory dashboard for a school-essentials store. Users can filter, sort and edit stock in a draft mode that commits changes in bulk.
highlights: Write-back draft mode batches edits so 10 changes need 1 API call instead of 10
Decoupled filter and product Pinia stores with a custom persistence plugin
No-stock/low-stock cues, ARIA labels and a Vitest unit test suite

projects.name: YouTube Jam
projects.description: A Vue 3 karaoke machine inspired by Spotify Jam and built on YouTube. Friends can queue songs, sync sessions and sing together.
highlights: Shared song queue with synced sessions across friends
Thin-client frontend architecture with realtime UX
Performance intros to boost singers' confidence

projects.name: Advanced RAG LLM App
projects.description: A question-answering assistant grounded in a controlled knowledge base. It combines document ingestion, hybrid vector and BM25 retrieval, prompt building with citations, and pluggable LLM providers.
highlights: Evaluation set of 41 labeled cases over 13 documents, including unanswerable questions
Offline default mode runs with zero API keys; OpenAI and Ollama providers optional
Single FastAPI service with Dockerfile and Render blueprint

projects.name: ContextLens
projects.description: A VS Code extension that shows who wrote a line, why, and what the PR discussion said. It follows git blame to the pull request and caches ranked comments locally.
highlights: Rate-limit-aware GitHub client with Retry-After and exponential backoff
Comment-ranking heuristic surfaces the top 3 most explanatory comments
SQLite cache via sql.js plus a background indexer for instant hovers

projects.name: vuln-priority-engine
projects.description: A tool that turns a scanner's flat CVE dump into a risk-ranked, SLA-bucketed remediation queue. It combines CVSS, EPSS exploit probability, CISA KEV and asset criticality.
highlights: Adapters for Trivy JSON and generic CVE CSV exports into one normalized model
Configurable weighted risk-scoring policy with SLA buckets
68-test pytest suite; runs fully offline on bundled data

projects.name: netcode-arena
projects.description: A 2-player arena with server-authoritative netcode built from scratch. It implements client-side prediction, server reconciliation and snapshot interpolation, tested under injected latency and packet loss.
highlights: Engine-agnostic C# simulation core shared by client prediction and server tick
Headless, Dockerized UDP dedicated server
Damage stays server-authoritative; no extrapolation through geometry

projects.name: field-ops-sql-cost-audit
projects.description: A tested dbt and SQL analytics layer that reconciles messy field-operations data. It computes true cost-to-serve per job and route and shows where SLA breaches concentrate.
highlights: Recursive CTEs for route sequencing and window functions for utilization
Layered staging, business-logic and reporting models
SQL logic tests and a GitHub Actions gate on every push

projects.name: ELT Pipeline: dbt + Snowflake + Airflow
projects.description: An ELT pipeline that extracts data from the Reddit and OpenWeather APIs and a SaaS PostgreSQL database, then loads it raw into Snowflake. dbt transforms it with testing, documentation and lineage.
highlights: dbt staging → intermediate → marts models with not_null, unique, accepted_values and freshness tests
Daily Apache Airflow DAG orchestrates async Python extractors with rate limiting
GitHub Actions runs dbt tests on PRs; Slack alerts on failures
